items.name: The Slasher
items.mainLimit: Needs clean timing before survivors reach safer routes
items.cardSummary: The Slasher is the baseline killer for learning ambushes, chases, and pallet pressure. He fits players who want a direct kit before saving Screws for a specialized unlock.

items.name: The Stalker
items.power: Stalk, Evil's Grasp, and Hunt Mode
items.mainStrength: Undetectable setup into a timed chase burst
items.mainLimit: Weak value if the stalk window is wasted or survivors stay alert
items.cardSummary: The Stalker starts quiet, builds pressure by watching survivors, then cashes that setup into Hunt Mode. He rewards patience before the chase becomes loud.
items.baseSpeed: 110% (18.7 studs/sec) in Stalker Mode; 120% (20.4 studs/sec) in Hunt Mode
items.intentRadius: 0 in Stalker Mode; 90 in Hunt Mode

items.name: The Hidden
items.mainStrength: Leap pressure around pallets, vaults, and walls
items.mainLimit: Mark is narrow and misses can leave painful endlag
items.cardSummary: The Hidden is for players who like quick routes and precise commitments. Leap helps cut through obstacles, while Mark rewards accurate reads more than panic swings.

items.name: The Killer
items.mainStrength: Punishes grouped survivors with chained hits
items.mainLimit: Whiffs, stuns, and split teams break the chain value
items.cardSummary: The Killer turns crowded routes into danger. Frenzy lets him vault and chain hits, so he is strongest when survivors cluster or hesitate in a chase path.
items.baseSpeed: 115% (19.6 studs/sec); Frenzy speeds up with chained hits

items.name: The Masked
items.mainStrength: Unpredictable speed, stealth, lunge, vault, or one-shot windows
items.mainLimit: Random masks make planning less consistent
items.cardSummary: The Masked changes the round through temporary masks. He suits players who can adapt quickly when a mask gives speed, stealth, longer lunges, faster vaults, or a one-shot threat.
items.intentRadius: 90 studs; Richter mask removes the radius

items.name: The Abysswalker
items.mainStrength: Multi-survivor pressure, slows, and map-wide disruption
items.mainLimit: Dark Severance can be crouch-dodged by prepared survivors
items.cardSummary: The Abysswalker is a control pick for players who want more than basic chase swings. His slash and burst can pressure objectives, loops, and grouped survivors.

items.name: The Veil
items.power: Pierced Vow and Through the Veil
items.mainStrength: Ranged zoning, wall shots, and generator-side pressure
items.mainLimit: Missed spears and cluttered cover reduce pressure fast
items.cardSummary: The Veil rewards aim and map reads. Spears let him zone routes, threaten straight-line movement, and punish predictable survivors through walls when the angle is right.

items.name: The Cure
items.power: Elucidation and I Am The Cure
items.mainStrength: Pestilence, spike pressure, and SCP-049-2 minions can snowball
items.mainLimit: Needs setup and can lose value if survivors avoid clouds and manage spikes
items.cardSummary: The Cure is the expensive control killer built around infection and minions. He fits players who want to spread pressure over time instead of winning every chase with one clean hit.
